title: Contact Spin the Wheel
description: Write to the owner of Spin the Wheel through the message form: wrong results, missing features, pricing or privacy requests.
heroText: This site is run by its owner, and the form below goes straight to them. Write about a result that looks wrong, a feature you miss, a question about why the site is free or a privacy request, and you will get a personal answer.

sections.title: What to write about
sections.body: Each kind of message is easiest to answer with the right details.

items.title: A result that looks wrong
items.body: Include what you entered and the result you expected. For a team split, paste the list and the team count; for a wheel spin, name the entries.

items.title: A missing feature
items.body: Say what you were trying to do and what you expected the tool to do. Feature requests steer what gets built next.

items.title: A pricing question
items.body: The whole site is free: no plans, no card, no ads. The [pricing page](/pricing/) explains what that covers and why.

items.title: Privacy or deletion
items.body: Say what you want removed and where it appeared. See the [privacy policy](/privacy/) for what the site keeps.

sections.title: What to expect
sections.body: Messages are read by the owner, usually answered within a few days. There is no phone line and no support team; the form is the way in, and it reaches a person.

sections.title: What this site cannot help with
sections.body: Spin the Wheel makes random draws; it cannot recover a purchase made on another site, mediate the outcome of your draw, or settle a dispute about who won your giveaway. Legal questions about your own event are yours to take to whoever runs it.
